hook: The herd has not returned, and a convincing story will not feed the camp.
readerPromise: A prehistoric philosophical adventure that turns evidence, story and uncertainty into immediate survival choices.
protectedRevelations: Later settlement transition, counting discoveries and political outcomes
visualPlan: The missing herd: Hold the hungry camp beside an empty route where the expected herd should have appeared. Introduce Ar and the River People around the small remaining food supply.

Which signs can guide us?: Let Ar point to an observed track while Karr holds attention with remembered words. Keep the possible routes open while the group recognizes it must move before knowing enough.
Thought beside the fire: Show counting stones, tracks and a fireside exchange in quick connected cuts. Let Kee and the others bring memory and food into the same conversation.
Join the River People: Keep a useful route mark beside an uncertainty mark rather than a guarantee. End at the first camp with the people preparing to decide, without revealing which route succeeds.

cueChanges.nextVisualChange: Open on the camp and absent herd signs, keeping hunger concrete without sensational distress.
Retain tracks and attentive human gestures; do not resolve which route is right.
Use one counting-stone movement beside the fire instead of teaching the later conceptual discovery.
Return to the group setting out in thought, with the actual journey reserved for reading.

independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. Replaced abstract promotional commentary with concrete viewer-facing language. All eight sentences have a distinct intended response and explicit restrained TTS direction; fictional later outcomes remain withheld. This is editorial review, not audience testing or rendered-audio approval. Reopened for the distinctive-contribution pass: concrete premises retained for fiction; proposed concepts, architectures and controversial positions now appear early where relevant. No unsupported world-first claim is made.

sentenceIntentions.text: The herd has not returned, and a convincing story will not feed the camp.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Make hunger expose the limits of a convincing story
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the immediate stakes of uncertainty

sentenceIntentions.text: Beyond the Last Stone begins with a prehistoric community facing hunger and an uncertain route forward.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the prehistoric community and missing herd

sentenceIntentions.text: Ar, a young hunter, asks what people have actually seen; others remember what stories can carry.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Introduce Ar's attention to observation beside shared stories

sentenceIntentions.text: They must decide together before anyone can be sure which signs to trust.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel why doubt alone cannot feed a camp

sentenceIntentions.text: Through tracks, counting stones, and fireside arguments, the novel makes early ideas about knowledge feel immediate.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Turn philosophy into tracks, stones and fireside disputes
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See abstract thought becoming lived adventure

sentenceIntentions.text: Its people need knowledge, but they also need courage, shared memory, and one another.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Keep courage and memory alongside knowledge
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Care about the social bonds supporting inquiry

sentenceIntentions.text: The adventure is discovering how an idea can guide a life without becoming a certainty.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Describe discovery as usable guidance without certainty

sentenceIntentions.text: Join the River People at the first hungry camp, where every claim has somewhere to lead.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Invite entry into the River People's hungry camp
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to follow the first consequential decision

distinctiveContribution: A hungry prehistoric community makes the tension between evidence, shared stories and necessary action into an immediate adventure.
